title: Pasting a screenshot into the Master page reaches the master on every install
description: A real browser against the served dashboard reached over HTTPS on a non-localhost origin (TLS terminated in front of the control plane, as tailscale serve does), with the loop's host bridge and a stub master pane on the host side: a screenshot-sized PNG pasted by keyboard, by the context-menu paste path and by drop is saved under .graphyard/master-inbox/ and the pane receives its absolute path as one bracketed paste, and that path is readable from inside the master session confinement; an image over the size limit and a read-only viewer's paste each show their reason on the page, never silence.

steps.name: Paste screenshots into the Master page over HTTPS on a non-localhost origin
